blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Department of Public Works (DPWH) chief Manuel Bonoan will remain an accused before the Sandiganbayan Second Division after it affirmed its ruling to deny the prosecution’s bid to discharge him from his remaining graft case. Bonoan’s graft case in this court division stemmed from his alleged conspiracy with Sen. Jinggoy Estrada to ensure the inclusion of flood control projects in Bulacan in the 2025 budget where the senator allegedly got a P213.7 million kickback. On Aug. 10, prosecution filed a motion for reconsideration (MR) on the Second Division’s denial of their motion to amend the information to discharge Bonoan, […]...
